summary: Iteration 24 backend testing for SpeakMateAI Phase 6 — 19/19 tests passed (100%). Validated (1) 3-day trial banner on Monthly plan via /api/system/pricing: plans.monthly.trial_days=3, cta='Start 3-day free trial', badge='3-Day Free Trial', features[0]={label:'3-day free trial', included:true, note:'New subscribers only'}; yearly/lifetime carry trial_days=null. (2) usage_tracker.get_user_active_plan(uid): returns None for fresh uid, returns 'monthly'/'yearly'/'lifetime' after /subscription/verify with respective SKUs, returns None for subscription with expires_at in the past. (3) Per-plan quota enforcement via /api/system/quota: free user (no X-Is-Premium) → tutor_chat.limit=10, roadmap=1, speaking_score=5; premium_monthly → plan='monthly', tutor_chat=30, roadmap=2; premium_yearly → plan='yearly', tutor_chat=100, roadmap=5; premium_lifetime → plan='lifetime', tutor_chat=100, roadmap=5. (4) check_user_quota logic: 31st tutor_chat call for premium monthly returns 'plan_quota_exceeded:monthly:tutor_chat:30/30'; premium user with plan=None returns None (safe unlimited fallback); plan auto-resolved from DB via get_user_active_plan when caller omits plan kwarg (yearly cap=100 verified with 50 calls under cap). (5) Regression: free tier caps unchanged, SKUs/prices unchanged (premium_monthly/yearly/lifetime, 149/799/1499), /rewarded/claim returns premium_no_bonus_needed for premium, /rewarded/ssv 400 on missing params, /verify 400 on unknown SKU.
critical_code_review_comments: usage_tracker.check_user_quota: when is_premium=True and endpoint is None but plan is known, function returns None immediately (line 284 short-circuits on `not endpoint`) — safe but means /admin/global-limit style guardrails don't apply to premium. Currently only per-endpoint caps enforce, no global cap for premium. Acceptable per design ('Global unlimited').

get_user_active_plan uses sort=granted_at desc but if a user has both an active monthly (expiring soon) and a later lifetime, the lifetime would win — correct. However, if lifetime has an earlier granted_at (edge: legacy re-verify), monthly wins. Rarely relevant but worth noting.
PlanConfig.trial_days emits `null` in JSON for yearly/lifetime — RN JSON parsing handles this, but frontend TS types should mark trial_days?: number | null.

record_user_call increments global user_usage.calls even for premium users on capped endpoints — cheap but means global counter reflects premium activity too. Not a bug; just noting for observability.
test_credentials: None — per-test UUID-based X-User-Ids to avoid cross-test collisions.
seed_data_creation: subscriptions collection: qa-iter24-* uids inserted via /subscription/verify (trust mode since GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON not configured, source=play_billing_unverified). One expired subscription doc directly inserted for the expiry test. user_usage/user_endpoint_usage docs written by record_user_call for cap tests. All keyed by unique UUIDs — no cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 6 backend is fully green. The trial_days migration branch in usage_tracker._get_state (checks monthly.trial_days) will re-run and repopulate plans if a future migration drops the field. Per-plan enforcement uses subscriptions collection; ensure /subscription/verify has been called before asserting premium caps. The auto-lookup path (check_user_quota with plan=None + is_premium=True) reads DB — do not mock in future tests. Frontend interstitialTrigger.ts was explicitly out of scope for this run.
